title: WorkItem
description: A single unit of work for Factorial. Every trigger adapter converts its input into exactly one WorkItem and places it on the Factorial event bus. This is Factorial's API: changing it is a deliberate, human-approved decision.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Incremented only for breaking changes.

id.description: Unique identifier for this WorkItem, assigned by the adapter that created it.

source.description: Where the work came from. Enough to trace back to, and report against, the originating record.

type.description: Trigger type in kebab-case, e.g. github-issue. New trigger types add a new value here without changing anything else in the contract.

id.description: Identifier of the originating record within its source system, e.g. the issue number.

repository.description: The code repository the work applies to.

provider.description: Hosting provider. Only GitHub is supported in Stage 0.

body.description: Full description of the work, in Markdown. May be empty.

requestedBy.description: Identity of the requester as known to the source system, e.g. a GitHub login.

createdAt.description: When the adapter created this WorkItem, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
